```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(rerddap)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)
```

# Reef Table
```{r}
NGBR_sites_for_coral_settlement_tiles <- read_excel("~/Larval recruitment resources/Maps/NGBR sites for coral settlement tiles.xlsx",
                                                  col_types = c("text", "numeric", "numeric", "text", "text"))

reefs <- NGBR_sites_for_coral_settlement_tiles |> group_by(Reef) |> summarise(
  lat = mean(Lat),
  lon = mean(Long)
)
```

```{r}
download_reef_chunks <- function(reefs,
                                 start_date = "2020-01-01",
                                 end_date   = "2025-04-01",
                                 batch_size = 6,
                                 chunk_months = 18,
                                 out_dir = "reef_raw") {
  
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  start_date <- as.Date(start_date)
  end_date   <- as.Date(end_date)
  
  time_starts <- seq(start_date, end_date, by = paste(chunk_months, "months"))
  reef_batches <- split(reefs, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(reefs)) / batch_size))
  
  for (t in seq_along(time_starts)) {
    
    chunk_start <- time_starts[t]
    chunk_end   <- min(chunk_start %m+% months(chunk_months) - days(1), end_date)
    
    for (b in seq_along(reef_batches)) {
      
      file_name <- paste0(
        out_dir, "/reef_batch_", b,
        "_", chunk_start, "_", chunk_end, ".rds"
      )
      
      if (file.exists(file_name)) {
        message("Skipping existing: ", file_name)
        next
      }
      
      message("Downloading: ", file_name)
      
batch_data <- pmap_dfr(
  reef_batches[[b]],
  function(Reef, lon, lat) {

    dat <- tryCatch(
      griddap(
        datasetx = "NOAA_DHW",
            url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/",
        time = c(as.character(chunk_start), as.character(chunk_end)),
        latitude = c(lat, lat),
        longitude = c(lon, lon),
        fields = c("CRW_SST", "CRW_DHW") # <- correct fields
      )$data,
      error = function(e) {
        message("Download failed for reef: ", Reef, " | Reason: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(dat)) return(NULL)

    dat %>%
      mutate(
        Reef = Reef,
        date   = as.Date(time),
        year   = year(date),
        month  = month(date)
      )
  }
)
      saveRDS(batch_data, file_name)
      Sys.sleep(1)
    }
  }
}

```

```{r}
download_reef_chunks(reefs)
```

```{r}
reef_daily <- combine_reef_data() # the full daily data for all reefs
reef_daily <- reef_daily %>%
  mutate(
    week  = isoweek(date),  # ISO week number (1–52/53)
    year  = year(date)
  )
```
